header.label: Open-source 2D CAD
header.title: Open 2D Studio
header.desc: A free, open-source 2D CAD application for technical drawings, floor plans, and mechanical designs. Lightweight, fast alternative to commercial CAD software.

drawing.title: Drawing tools
drawing.desc: Line, rectangle, circle, arc, polyline, ellipse, and text. CAD-style command input for precise control.

snapping.title: Precision and snapping
snapping.desc: Snap to grid and object snaps: endpoint, midpoint, center, intersection. Configurable grid system.

layers.title: Layer management
layers.desc: Multiple layers with visibility, lock, and color controls. Organize drawings into logical groups.

dxf.title: DXF import/export
dxf.desc: Read and write DXF files via the Rust dxf-rs backend for interoperability with AutoCAD, BricsCAD, and other CAD software.

properties.title: Properties and selection
properties.desc: Edit stroke color, width, and line style. Click, box select, or Shift+Click to build selections. Multi-select alignment and distribution.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.desc: Extensible architecture for add-ins. See Drawing Statistics for an example extension.

tauri.title: Tauri 2.0
tauri.desc: ~10 MB app size, ~30 MB RAM usage, native performance via Rust backend.

react.title: React 18 + TypeScript
react.desc: Component-based UI with type safety and Zustand state management.

canvas.title: Canvas 2D rendering
canvas.desc: Fast rendering that handles 10k+ elements smoothly.
